metadata.title: Sprout · grow your software skills
metadata.description: Bite-sized, playful mini-courses on software engineering, AI coding agents and the soft skills around them.

landing.heroTitle: Software skills, one small sprout at a time.
landing.heroDescription: Sprout teaches how software really gets built: requirements, teamwork, testing, and how to work with AI coding agents without letting them drive. Made for curious non-CS folks and CS grads getting job-ready.
landing.pipGreeting: Hi, I am Pip. I grow a new leaf every time you level up.
landing.footer: Built by a student team for COMP software engineering, 2026. Prototype, demo data only.

practice.title: Practise the awkward parts
practice.description: Run a requirements meeting with a picky client or sit a mock interview. The other side is played by AI, and it gives you honest feedback afterwards.

learn.title: Learn by poking at things
learn.description: Sort cards, put steps in order, fix code that an AI agent got wrong. Short lessons, then you try it straight away.

compete.title: See how the class is doing
compete.description: A weekly leaderboard and a course race show who is ahead and by how much. Friendly pressure, opt-in nicknames.

custom.title: Any topic, your pace
custom.description: Type what you want to learn and Pip builds you a mini-course. Teachers can do the same for their own classes.
